[[File:Point_Nadir.jpg|thumb|The Slips on the Point Nadir's map.]]
The '''Slips''' was an area of the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]] [[Point Nadir]], located on the [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Resh 9376/Legends|Resh 9376]]. It was a series of docking facilities located at the end of the [[Jackrab Hole]] that extended for 200 yards before giving way to other districts. In addition to landing platforms with inertial generators it featured several [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] for [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and crew unwilling to venture too far from their ships. More expensive, but with a higher reputation than the [[Tethers]], the Slips was a place where [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and merchants willing to move significant cargo made efforts to dock their [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Well-accommodated, the Slips offered more comfort than a typical shadowport, however the prices were still huge compared with legitimate equivalents. The Slips were fully controlled by [[Epsis (organization)|Epsis]], who kept the shadowport utilities running at full capacity.<ref name="SaV">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>
